race.comment: HIDDEN WITNESS (10) kept coming but just failed to pick up the winner last start over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic. Has race fitness on her side now. Nicely placed to play a major role. MANCHEGO (3) booted up from the inside draw to lead when returning from a spell last start and was there on straightening before being claimed and finishing 2.75 lengths away in third over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic. Solid run last time and will take catching again. SHAMATEUR (1) finished 4 lengths away in sixth last time out over 1008m at Mildura two weeks ago. Tackles a longer journey this time. Strong top-three chance. HARRY DEVIL (2) resumes here and hasn't done anything in three fresh runs yet but has logged a couple of jumpout second placings in preparation for this. SALINA SPECIAL (4) is first up from a tricky gate but showed good talent in the debut prep and looks to have more upside than most rivals.
